entries.title: THE THIRTEENTH WOLF
entries.author: Gav Thorpe
entries.currentBlurb: A lost Space Wolf seeks his pack during the Heresy's chaos.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: A warrior of Fenris searches for his brothers in the galaxy's darkest hour.

entries.title: INTO EXILE
entries.author: Aaron Dembski-Bowden
entries.currentBlurb: Word Bearers embrace their exile from the Emperor's light, finding new purpose in darkness.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The XVII Legion accepts their damnation and finds strength in corruption.

entries.title: CYBERNETICA
entries.author: Rob Sanders
entries.currentBlurb: Battle-automata serve their masters in the civil war, unthinking and relentless.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The Mechanicum's robots fight without question or mercy.

entries.title: THE BINARY SUCCESSION
entries.author: David Annandale
entries.currentBlurb: The Mechanicum's succession of power becomes a battleground during Mars's schism.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Political intrigue on Mars mirrors the galaxy's larger civil war.

entries.title: PERPETUAL
entries.author: Dan Abnett
entries.currentBlurb: The Perpetuals Oll Persson and John Grammaticus navigate the Heresy, their immortality granting perspective on humanity's civil war.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Immortal beings watch humanity tear itself apart, their ancient wisdom unable to prevent the tragedy.

entries.title: ORDO SINISTER
entries.author: John French
entries.currentBlurb: The sinister Psi-Titans of the Ordo Sinister emerge to defend Terra.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The Emperor's most terrible weapons awaken for the coming siege.

entries.title: THE WOLF KING
entries.author: Chris Wraight
entries.currentBlurb: Leman Russ leads his Wolves through the Heresy, the Wolf King's fury undiminished.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The Primarch of the VI Legion commands his sons in the war for humanity's soul.

entries.title: THE HEART OF THE PHAROS
entries.author: L J Goulding
entries.currentBlurb: The Pharos device's power corrupts those who seek to control it.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: An ancient xenos device becomes a weapon and a curse.
